title: The Legends of Comedy VHS 1996 Sealed Abbott Costello Chaplin Marx Brothers
descriptionText:
The Legends of Comedy (1996, Diamond Entertainment, DEC 16971) - a collection of vintage film clips and classic movie trailers featuring the funniest performers of Hollywood's Golden Age.

Featuring: Abbott & Costello, Charlie Chaplin, Buster Keaton, Laurel & Hardy, The Marx Brothers, Lucille Ball & Desi Arnaz, Bob Hope, Bing Crosby, Dean Martin, Jerry Lewis, Red Skelton and Harold Lloyd.

- VHS, approx. 60 minutes, SP speed
- Made in USA

Condition: factory sealed, never opened. The shrink wrap has a few small tears (see photos); the sleeve underneath is clean.

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
